title: Teaching himself guitar from a method; rehearsals under Hippolyte Charles
summary: Dawson learned guitar from a method book; good bands read and played by ear, rehearsal mattered, and Hippolyte Charles demanded it unpaid.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
